text:
Mira: quick check — compact playground shows a weird token "ghost" when you insert something from Prompt Shelf during streaming. it briefly shows a final number, then the badge disappears.

Ben: compact rail only? or both composer modes?

Mira: seen in the compact rail. full composer keeps the badge. likely a render/state race in the compact layout.

Tess: a11y flag 12; screen readers are getting noisy with every chunk update. we should avoid announcing partial counts.

Jordan: can we make the live indicator purely visual (no aria updates) and then emit a single announcement when generation ends? that should quiet screen readers.

Mira: yep. idea: a small, dim live estimate that doesn't trigger aria-live, and a final, clearly labeled pill announced once on completion. visually distinct and less jumpy.

Ben: implementation note 12; throttle visual updates (say 500ms) and debounce finalization by a few hundred ms so late chunks don't flip it twice.

Tess: copy suggestion for the stop control: visible label "Stop" but accessible name "Stop streaming response (Esc)". adds context for screen reader users without cluttering UI.

Mira: prompt-shelf behavior: current quick-insert cancels stream and drops partial output. i'd rather we queue the insert and show a small banner "Insert queued 12; will apply when generation stops" with an "Undo" action.

Jordan: queue+banner seems least surprising. we can stash client-side and apply on next stop/regenerate. bake an analytics ping for queued-inserts.

aria-bot: color contrast check: token badge color fails AA for small text on white. recommend a darker fill or use bold white type.

Ben: ok i'll prototype: 1) visual-only live estimate + 500ms throttle, 2) final pill aria-live polite + aria-atomic, 3) queued-insert client stash + banner + undo, 4) stop accessible name change.

Mira: perfect. i'll add a tiny interaction doc and a Figma snippet for the dim/live vs final pill states and the queued banner copy. will post links here when ready.

Tess: thanks 12; i'll add the accessibility checklist and validate with NVDA/VoiceOver on the spike.

Ben: taking the spike, 2 days. will report back with reflow numbers and a quick demo.

Mira: thanks all :thumbsup:
